title: kinetics1D operation
description: One-dimensional batch kinetics bench: integrates c(t) for an nth-order rate, overlays a measured dataset when one is declared, and — with a `fit` list — regresses the rate constant or the Arrhenius pair (k0, Ea) from the data. The MODEL-DISCRIMINATION lesson lives here: the same dataset run at order 1 and order 2 shows which residuals carry structure, which is adequacy, not consistency.

rate.title: Rate law
rate.description: `{ order <n>; c0 ...; k ...; }` — the reaction order, the initial concentration, and the rate constant either directly (`k`) or as an Arrhenius pair (`k0`, `Ea`, with the evaluation `T`).

state.title: State block
state.description: Alternative home for `c0`, mirroring the other bench ops.

time.title: Time span
time.description: `{ from 0; to ...; n ...; }` — the integration window; n defaults to 61.

dataset.title: Measured dataset
dataset.description: Path to a self-describing kinetic dataset to overlay and, with `fit`, regress against.

fit.title: Parameters to fit
fit.description: Which rate parameters to regress from the dataset — `( k )` or `( k0 Ea )` for the Arrhenius pair.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
